purpose: Example routes verified against the local Hermes profile configs; recheck before reuse

planner.role: Select and plan scope; inspect sources read-only; attach immutable plan; request independent native review; do not implement

plan-reviewer.role: Independently review the planner's exact artifact on the same card; never grant product approval or edit implementation

orchestrator.role: After owner approval create and verify gated card graph; no implementation, review, release, or product decisions

implementor.role: Implement one approved lane in an isolated branch/worktree; commit only that branch; request native spec review

spec-reviewer.role: Native same-card read-only spec and project-invariant review; approve or request changes; do not modify code

quality-security-reviewer.role: Independent downstream correctness/security review; do not modify code or release a failed gate

integrator.role: Prepare prospective integration candidate, then promote only E2E-proven SHA to dev; never main

e2e-tester.role: Run exact-candidate E2E and record evidence/cleanup; do not fix code or promote branches
